codex-bonus-hierarchie-complete-de-la-ma.title: Bonus — Complete Hierarchy of Grand Patron Luigi's Mafia
codex-bonus-hierarchie-complete-de-la-ma.html:
1. Grand Patron Luigi

Absolute Authority

Final decision on everything.

No checks or balances.

Can wipe out any level instantly.

Never justifies his decisions — or almost never, if he feels like it.

Source of every modification and creation.

He is the structure itself.

2. Agent 47

Direct Extension

Created and supervised personally by Luigi.

Undocumented training.

Knows the exact mechanism of the modifications.

Can modify a soldier.

Can neutralize a commander.

Has authority over everyone except Luigi.

He is not a subordinate.

He is the operational arm of the top.

3. The Two German Scientists

Supreme Scientific Authority

In charge of advanced research.

Have worked on forbidden projects (e.g. The Black Eclipse).

Access to sensitive technologies.

Above the secondary commanders.

Position based on competence and Luigi's trust.

They are powerful...

but entirely dependent on the will of the top.

4. Secondary Commanders (7)

Operational Leadership

Lead military divisions.

Oversee bases and fleets.

Manage interdimensional operations.

Do not know the exact mechanism of the modifications.

Obey 47.

Heavy responsibility.

Repeated failure = replacement.

5. Modified Soldiers

Main Force

Some recruited, all modified.

Aware that they are modified.

Completely unaware of the mechanism.

Total allegiance.

Incapable of betrayal.

Standard internal military hierarchy.

Their loyalty is structurally guaranteed.

47 can intervene on them.

6. Slaves

Logistics Workforce

Transport.

Service.

Thankless tasks.

No strategic access.

No decision-making power.

They serve only to support the infrastructure.

They are not part of the chain of command.

They are mistreated and unpaid; according to Grand Patron Luigi, they should be grateful to be on his team.

codex-chapitre-i-l-origine-de-kj.title: Chapter I — The Origin of KJ
codex-chapitre-i-l-origine-de-kj.html: KJ predates everything, at once light and void. He embodies the separation between being and non-being, between creation and annihilation. His five soul fragments ensure his cohesion and his power over causality. Wherever KJ turns his attention, reality bends, changes or fades away. KJ is at once law and chaos, creation and destruction, guardian and player. His existence escapes all measure, and his will alone sets the limit of what is possible. KJ is unique.

codex-chapitre-ii-la-fratrie-des-puissan.title: Chapter II — The Siblings of Power
codex-chapitre-ii-la-fratrie-des-puissan.html:
KJ's siblings are made up of four primordial entities:

  • JK (Navy blue): after a 21-second confrontation (a very long fight, given KJ's power), he was sealed in the Cube of the Void, a luxurious chamber of about 3 square meters. KJ entrusted the cube to the Sect, warning them that JK would escape.

  • Void (Dark gray): he was a god of death in Paradise, but after a fight against an Incarnation, KJ captured him to corrupt him with a part of his soul, and he became the third Higher Incarnation.

  • Kuj (White): benevolent, he is in Paradise with Void before his corruption. He does not know JK exists, but knows KKJ and KJ.

  • KKJ (Pink): incarnation of love and peace. She has a personal dimension. She does not know JK, but sometimes visits KJ without knowing his true power.

Their relationship is ambivalent: domination, defiance, balance and ignorance coexist.

codex-chapitre-iii-les-fragments-d-ame.title: Chapter III — The Soul Fragments
codex-chapitre-iii-les-fragments-d-ame.html:
• 5 fragments inside KJ: total control over causality and domains.

  • 1 fragment in Paradise: subtle observation of the gods and deities. KJ practically never goes to Paradise, but watches them in view of its future destruction.

  • 1 fragment in the Pope of the Sect: KJ entrusts part of his divine power to the Pope. When the Pope dies, the transmission ritual must be performed within 21 hours, otherwise it constitutes an affront to KJ.

The ritual takes place in three steps:

1. The body is placed on the ritual table.

2. The arm is cut off to collect the blood used to draw the symbol 21.

3. The successor chosen by the Pope stands before the Mirror of Infinity and must accept.

If KJ accepts, the chosen one sees and hears KJ, who speaks to them and gives them instructions.

If the chosen one is not accepted, the mirror turns red and the individual is sent to the Imperial Palace to fight KJ.

Only KJ knows where all the fragments are.

codex-chapitre-iv-la-secte-de-kj.title: Chapter IV — The Sect of KJ
codex-chapitre-iv-la-secte-de-kj.html:
• Origin: since the invention of writing, the Sect has roamed the world with the aim of worshipping KJ.

  • Hierarchy: KJ → Pope → 21 Cult Masters → Initiates → Apprentices.

  • Key rituals: the October 8th Feast, the Fragment Transmission Rite, the passage from Apprentice to Initiate.

  • Artifacts: the Key of Infinity, the Mirror of Infinity.

  • Discipline: sleeping less than one hour a night and committing cannibalistic acts.

  • Current members: 789.

codex-chapitre-v-les-territoires-et-leur.title: Chapter V — Domains and Their Functions
codex-chapitre-v-les-territoires-et-leur.html:
• Simple domain: used to counter an equal or lesser domain.

  • Zone domain: traps targets in a defined space depending on the caster's power.

  • Soul domain: an ontological projection of its creator.

  • KJ's domain: a unique type of domain. KJ can master every existing domain, but almost exclusively uses the form of the Imperial Palace, whose power cancels the powers of souls and objects.

  • Key of Infinity: the key to the door of the Imperial Palace, used by the Sect only during certain rituals. Any unauthorized use constitutes an affront to KJ.

  • Artifact of Fire: created by the Inferis for Ignis, of immeasurable power.

  • Manuscript: the secrets of creation, readable only by KJ.

  • Unknown floor: a constantly updated library containing all the secrets of creation.

codex-chapitre-x-civilisations-eteintes.html:

  • The カオス (Kaosu): created by the Assimilated's domain. They rejected the supremacy of KJ and of chaos. The Assimilated exterminated almost all of them; the survivors are tortured on a floor known only to KJ and the Assimilated.

  • Si Umatis: a technological civilization that defied KJ. Annihilated despite its ability to manipulate reality on a small scale.

  • Servi Glacieis: creatures of pure ice created by Glacius, destroyed by a heat wave from Ignis.

  • Na Luve Ni Veibuli: creators of the race ranking, destroyed by KJ for reading the Manuscript.

  • Демоны: a civilization of emptiness and void, destroyed during the expansion of the universe.

codex-chapitre-xiii-pactes.title: Chapter XIII — Pacts
codex-chapitre-xiii-pactes.html:
• Anyone can declare a pact, but for it to work, you must say:

"The truth shall line our soul, I accept the pact and its consequences."

  • Possible consequences of breaking a pact:

1. Torture on a floor of the Imperial Palace.

2. Obliteration of the soul in every universe, except for KJ, the Higher and Lower Incarnations, and the gods, who are immune to this effect of the pact.

3. Destruction of the person's reality and timeline, and of their plane of existence, except for KJ and the Higher Incarnations.

  • Only KJ can cancel a pact, or another soul authorized by KJ.

  • KJ is immune.

  • Any attempt to curse KJ results in the obliteration of the caster's soul.

If no judgment can be reached, it is sent to Purgatory.

In Purgatory, a deity called the Queen of Judgment sends the soul to the Imperial Palace to be judged by an Incarnation — and, very rarely, by KJ in person.

2. Higher demon

3. Lower demon

4. Weak demon

codex-chapitre-xxix-la-division-de-l-uni.title: Chapter XXIX — The Division of the Universe
codex-chapitre-xxix-la-division-de-l-uni.html:
Before the great known wars, before the modern pacts, before most conscious civilizations even understood that cosmic powers existed, there was a meeting almost no one knows about: the first encounter between KJ and Grand Patron Luigi.

No witness remains.

No complete text records the words spoken.

Only consequences remain, visible on the scale of the entire universe.

I — The First Meeting

When KJ and Grand Patron Luigi faced each other for the first time, no battle took place.

KJ knew he was standing before the only being he could not fully observe.

Grand Patron Luigi knew he was standing before the only cosmic authority capable of reshaping reality on a scale comparable to his own.

An immediate conflict would have threatened the very structure of existence.

So they chose what almost no one would have imagined of them:

negotiation.

II — The Great Accord

The two entities concluded a treaty known by several lost names:

  • The Pact of the Two Thrones

  • The Primordial Partition

  • The Accord of Silence

  • The Division of the Universe

Under this accord, the observable universe was split into two absolute spheres of influence:

  • KJ's Side

  • Grand Patron Luigi's Side

In each half:

  • the dominant laws differ;

  • outside interventions are limited;

  • agents of the other camp operate there at great risk;

  • local authority takes precedence over all others.

III — KJ's Side

In the portion governed by KJ:

  • pacts are stronger;

  • soul fragments circulate more easily;

  • the Sect's rituals become more effective;

  • manifestations of the Incarnations are favored;

  • anomalies are detected more quickly.

Judgment, causality and structure respond more to KJ's will there.

Even far from the Imperial Palace, his influence is constant.

IV — Grand Patron Luigi's Side

In the portion governed by Grand Patron Luigi:

  • technological systems run at maximum efficiency;

  • social influence networks spread faster;

  • military and mafia operations are made easier;

  • means of concealment become more effective;

  • modified chains of command stabilize naturally.

Cunning, material domination, strategic fear and logistical power thrive there.

V — The Dividing Line

Between the two realms lies an invisible cosmic border called:

  • The Central Line

  • The Rift of the Partition

  • The Limit of the Two Wills

It is neither a wall, nor a portal, nor visible energy.

It is a break in authority.

Crossing it means entering the other sovereign's zone of influence.

Some entities feel the transition immediately.

Others vanish while trying to force it without permission.

VI — The Unique Case of Earth

Earth holds a singular position:

it sits exactly on the Dividing Line.

The human world is therefore split between the two powers.

One half of the globe belongs to KJ's sphere of influence.

The other belongs to Grand Patron Luigi's.

No standard human civilization is aware of it.

And yet, many invisible conflicts take place there:

  • clashes between the Sect and mafia agents;

  • unexplained disappearances near certain zones;

  • localized anomalies;

  • struggles for influence over governments;

  • secret wars for control of strategic points.

VII — Tensions and Violations

The treaty has never been officially broken.

However, indirect violations are frequent:

  • infiltration of agents;

  • clandestine rituals;

  • contract killings;

  • artifact thefts;

  • experiments in contested zones.

Earth has become the main stage for these tensions, because neither camp wants to give up its portion of the world.

VIII — The Silence Clause

One last clause is said to have been imposed during the accord:

Neither KJ nor Grand Patron Luigi may publicly reveal the full treaty to the lesser peoples.

The exact reason remains unknown.

Some believe that knowledge of this division would cause the political collapse of thousands of worlds.

Others believe it would automatically void the pact.

IX — A Precarious Balance

Since that day, the universe has not lived under a single master.

It lives under a forced balance between two wills capable of turning everything upside down.

KJ reigns over one half.

Grand Patron Luigi reigns over the other.

And Earth, cut in two without knowing it, remains at the center of a silent conflict of which humanity glimpses only the shadows.

"Two kings divided infinity between them.

The stars obeyed.

The worlds trembled.

The humans noticed nothing."

— Anonymous fragment of the Codex Infinitum.

codex-chapitre-xxv-grand-patron-luigi.title: Chapter XXV — Grand Patron Luigi
codex-chapitre-xxv-grand-patron-luigi.html:
I — Identity

  • Official name: unknown, nicknamed "He Whose Name Must Not Be Spoken".

  • Species: human, a cosmic anomaly comparable to KJ

  • Age: born in 300,000 BC.

  • Status: head of an interdimensional mafia, omnipresent and immortal

  • Reputation: feared and respected by humanity, Paradise, Hell and cosmic entities

  • Cosmic ranking: equal to KJ, the only being KJ cannot observe, which keeps KJ constantly on guard

II — Empire and Infrastructure

Strategic bases

  • Antarctica: Hell on Earth (execution and training rooms, the AI Reaper)

  • Mars: The Red Death (laboratories, weapons, planetary shield)

  • The Sun: The Tower of He Whose Name Must Not Be Spoken (ultimate strategic center)

Properties on Earth: Sapienza, Burj Khalifa, the Maldives, Los Angeles, North Korea, England, Argentina, Berlin, the Carpathians, China.

Agents and commanders

  • Agent 47: lethal right-hand man, the second most dangerous being after Grand Patron Luigi. Created in a laboratory with part of Grand Patron Luigi's DNA. The perfect assassin: discreet, a master of disguise, leaves no trace. Sole survivor of the 47 clones. Loyal, mentally incorruptible, absolute expert in every weapon, poison, explosive and form of close combat. Cold, taciturn, rigid in his movements, an absolute observer.

  • Other agents: genetically modified, overtrained, loyal, but never at Agent 47's level.

Technology and weapons

  • The AI Reaper: an artificial intelligence programmed by Luigi, a completely unhackable computer system.

  • Personal weapons: sniper rifle, AK-47, explosive weapon, madness powder.

  • Bases equipped with unhackable systems, deadly traps and an absurd number of guards.

III — Fleets and Ships

Mothership

  • An invisible 47 km fortress holding half of the mafia

  • Resistant to everything: temperatures, domains, explosions, reality manipulation

  • Manual and automatic piloting

  • Grand Patron X47 missiles, capable of wiping out Paradise with a single nanometer of the missile

Secondary ships

  • 46 secondary ships for interstellar control

  • 47 submarines, including one flagship, capable of planetary destruction

The Black Eclipse — Corrupted ship

  • A forbidden experiment carried out by the two German scientists

  • A creature that annihilated the crew

  • Ship sealed and abandoned in the void by Reaper

  • Permanent surveillance ensured by Reaper

IV — First Attack and Reactions

  • An employee made a mistake, disabling the cloaking of one of Grand Patron Luigi's ships.

  • A Lower Incarnation saw it and attempted an attack; the security systems and guards neutralized it instantly.

  • The employee was abandoned in the void, never recovered, and died.

  • KJ did not react, acting as if it had never happened.

  • The Incarnations were stunned by the power and speed: Grand Patron Luigi remains invisible and untraceable; KJ never knows where his ships are.

V — Media and Social Influence

  • Social networks: Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X.

  • Followers: 6 billion on each platform.

  • Content: vacation photos, torture and murders, follower challenges.

  • Impact: a single post can cause social chaos, wars, economic ruin, or a world war and/or total war

  • Power: no one can delete his accounts, because they are hosted on the ship's servers — and even if someone managed it, it would end badly.

VI — Victim Count

  • Direct victims: > 47 quadrillion.

  • Total victims (mafia + indirect + erased realities): incalculable.

  • Method: lethal continuity; every action becomes a tool of death.

  • Even the Higher Incarnations and KJ acknowledge the gravity of this toll.

VII — Psychology and Urges

  • Psychopath and cosmic madman: loves murder, torture, extreme suffering.

  • Control: 999 years out of 1000; he channels his urges into strategy and efficiency.

  • Millennial crises: once every 1000 years, control is lost; massacres of realities and cosmic destruction.

  • Massacre of realities: every reality is put under quarantine, even the Imperial Palace.

  • Permanent effects: some realities become unrecoverable; timelines are altered; civilizations are erased.

VIII — Laws and Security

  • The Ten-Meter Law: it is forbidden to speak to him, approach him, stand within 10 meters of him, think about him consciously or unconsciously, or exist during his crises.

  • Violation: instant death, local destruction of reality, or damnation of the soul.

  • Universal respect: even KJ and the Higher Incarnations strictly observe this rule.

IX — Absolute Power

  • Military domination: fleets, submarines, X47 missiles.

  • Social domination: global influence through social networks and reputation.

  • Cosmic domination: millennial massacres of realities to channel chaos.

  • Psychological domination: pure terror, manipulation and widespread paranoia.

  • Even KJ recognizes Grand Patron Luigi as a living force of destruction and chaos.

X — Agent Training

I — Emergence

Each agent is born in a creation pod.

On emerging, there is no past, no civil identity, no attachment.

They exist only as a tool.

II — Phase I: Physical Conditioning (10 years)

Duration: 10 consecutive years.

Goal: test and push biological limits.

Training

  • Extreme endurance (sleep deprivation, cold, heat, pressure)

  • Continuous close combat

  • Pain resistance

  • Adaptation to variable gravity

  • Survival in hostile environments

Purpose

Break natural limits and measure bodily stability.

Unstable subjects are eliminated.

III — Phase II: Intellectual Training (14 years)

Duration: 14 years.

Goal: build a cognitive weapon.

Teachings

  • Advanced military strategy

  • Behavioral psychology

  • Social manipulation

  • Multiple languages

  • Science, technology, digital infiltration

  • Interdimensional geopolitical history

This phase tests the capacity for analysis, anticipation and planning.

An agent must think faster than their opponent.

IV — Phase III: Operational Training (8 years)

Duration: 8 years.

Goal: test abilities in real situations.

Agents receive:

  • Infiltration missions

  • Targeted assassination

  • Strategic sabotage

  • Extraction

  • Conflict manipulation

Every mission is monitored.

Repeated failure = disappearance.

Success = permanent integration into the operational hierarchy.

Total training time: 32 years

A fully operational agent is the result of:

10 years of physical forging

14 years of intellectual construction

8 years of real-world trials

codex-chapitre-xxvi-agent-47-le-dieu-de-.title: Chapter XXVI — Agent 47: The God of Death
codex-chapitre-xxvi-agent-47-le-dieu-de-.html:
I — Origin and Nature

Agent 47 was not born.

He was manufactured.

Designed personally by Grand Patron Luigi under undocumented conditions, he is the result of a process of which no official archive holds a complete record. Forty-six clones were produced before him. None survived the creation protocol.

He alone came out stable.

He has no civilian past. No legal identity. No childhood, no memory before his first mission.

He exists only as a tool.

A perfect tool.

II — Allegiance and Command

Agent 47 takes orders from only one source: Grand Patron Luigi.

No secondary commander, no cosmic entity, no Higher Incarnation can give him instructions.

He recognizes no other authority.

This is not disobedience.

It is design.

Grand Patron Luigi never gives him pointless orders. He gives him objectives.

The difference is absolute: an order leaves room. An objective is an end state to be reached, by any path, with any method deemed necessary.

47 has never failed an objective.

He has never disobeyed.

He has never asked a question.

III — Artificial Anatomy

Because of his constructed nature, Agent 47 has biological advantages that place him beyond any human comparison.

Bone structure

His bones are not made of organic matter.

They are made of the same unidentified metal used to build Grand Patron Luigi's Mothership.

This metal withstands extreme temperatures, inhuman pressures and large-scale explosions.

As a result, Agent 47's vital points are not vulnerable in the same way as those of a standard biological being. Fractures, impacts, falls from abnormal heights — his skeleton takes it where any other body would collapse.

Musculature and reflexes

His muscle density exceeds natural biological limits, without any visible excess of bulk. He moves with a fluidity and economy of motion that make his presence hard to perceive until it is too late.

Neurology

No measurable variation in heart rate in the face of danger.

No identifiable stress response.

His nervous system processes a threat the same way it processes silence: without emotional distinction.

IV — Weaponry and Signature

Absolute silence

All the weapons used by Agent 47 are fitted with total sound-suppression systems, developed in the laboratories of the Martian base The Red Death, under the direct supervision of Grand Patron Luigi. No shot can be heard. No detonator leaves a detectable sound signature. He operates in complete silence, whether the target is one meter or two kilometers away.

The engraved bullets

Every bullet fired by Agent 47 bears, engraved in the metal, the number: 47.

This metal is the same as that of his bones and of Grand Patron Luigi's Mothership — unidentified by any known terrestrial or cosmic analysis. The most advanced human laboratories, like the entities that have tried to study it, have never been able to determine its composition.

The engraving is not a deliberate signature meant for the public.

It is a manufacturing mark built in by Grand Patron Luigi from the design stage.

But its effects on the outside world were unexpected.

V — The Legend: The God of Death

The first bodies appeared without explanation.

Isolated corpses. Targets of every origin — humans, creatures, entities — found with a single constant: a bullet in the body, bearing the number 47 engraved in a metal no one could name.

Human law enforcement had no leads.

Intelligence services found no shooter.

Cameras never captured anything usable: a silhouette, sometimes. A shadow. Nothing more.

The bodies piled up over decades, centuries, millennia.

Always the same bullet. Always the same number. Never the same place, never the same context.

Urban legends emerged naturally.

People spoke of a supernatural being.

Of an entity that passed through walls, crossed borders without a trace, struck without a sound and vanished without explanation.

The number of deaths attributed to this mark became so colossal that some civilizations, in their attempt to rationalize the inexplicable, mistook its author for Death itself.

The nickname took hold on its own, across languages, eras, universes:

The God of Death.

He is not aware of it.

He couldn't care less.

VI — Modus Operandi

Agent 47 leaves no usable trace.

He follows no recurring movement pattern. He never repeats a method. He adapts each mission to its exact conditions, which makes any attempt to anticipate his path impossible.

He has mastered every known weapon, every catalogued poison, every infiltration method, every close-combat technique.

But his preference goes to distance and silence.

Grand Patron Luigi has given him access to weapons protocols that no other agent of the mafia can access. These protocols are neither documented nor shared. Only Agent 47 knows their exact extent.

A target dead without a sound, without chaos, without a surviving witness: that is his minimum operational standard.

When an engraved bullet is found, it means only one thing:

47 wanted people to know it was him.

Or he had no reason to hide the result.

VII — Cosmic Recognition

The Higher Incarnations are aware of his existence.

KJ is aware of it.

It is accepted in the higher spheres that Agent 47 has the ability to wound or kill a Higher Incarnation.

This is not a rumor.

It is assessed seriously.

No Higher Incarnation has tried to eliminate him preemptively.

No order has been given to neutralize him.

There is a silent, permanent, unspoken tension.

Even KJ has never tried to act against him.

Grand Patron Luigi has never ordered Agent 47 to attack a Higher Incarnation.

The confrontation has not happened yet.

It remains theoretical.

For now.

VIII — What He Is Not

Agent 47 is not a legend he cultivates.

He is not a myth reveling in its reputation.

He is not a killer driven by hatred, pleasure or ideology.

He is empty.

Not broken. Not traumatized. Not resigned.

Structurally, fundamentally empty.

This emptiness is his most absolute weapon.

A being driven by hatred can be manipulated.

A being driven by pride can be provoked.

An empty being offers no handhold.

He feels neither fear, nor admiration, nor curiosity toward whatever he encounters.

He assesses. He calculates. He acts.

That's all.

Grand Patron Luigi created the perfect assassin.

Not because he is the strongest.

But because he is the only one with no inner limit to exploit.

"There is no target he has not reached.

There is no place he cannot enter.

There is no sound that precedes his passing.

Only, afterward — a bullet. An engraved number. And silence."

Excerpt from an anonymous testimony, origin and era unknown.

codex-chapitre-xxvii-les-planetes-princi.title: Chapter XXVII — The Main Planets
codex-chapitre-xxvii-les-planetes-princi.html:
The universe is not just its cosmic entities.

It is also its territories.

Every planet is a piece. Every piece has a role.

Some are home to civilizations. Others, to secrets.

And some are home to a single presence.

A presence that is enough.

I — Earth

Classification: Living planet. Priority observation zone.

Status: Inhabited. Not governed by any direct cosmic entity.

Physical appearance

Earth is a medium-sized planet, more than two-thirds covered by oceans. Its continents are fragmented, its terrain varied — mountains, deserts, dense forests, frozen plains. Seen from space, it looks blue, fragile, almost insignificant on a cosmic scale.

It is.

Inhabitants and civilizations

Earth is mainly inhabited by humans — a species ranked 10th in the race ranking established by the Na Luve Ni Veibuli. A short-lived species, limited in its perception of the cosmos, but remarkably unstable in its behavior: wars, alliances, betrayals, creations, destructions.

Other entities live there or pass through discreetly: weak demons, uncatalogued mythical creatures, agents of Grand Patron Luigi's mafia, and members of the Sect of KJ, present on Earth since the invention of writing.

The vast majority of humans are unaware of the existence of KJ, the Higher Incarnations, the Imperial Palace, and Grand Patron Luigi's mafia.

Which does nothing to protect them.

History and key events

  • The Sect of KJ has roamed the Earth since the dawn of writing, hidden within human structures.

  • The War of the Distancing took place on Earth: a clash between the Sect and the Mystic bloodline, ending in the near-extinction of the latter. Only Takeshi and his father survived.

  • Grand Patron Luigi's agents regularly operate on Earth, without human governments being aware of it.

  • KJ watches Earth through his soul fragment in Paradise. He does not go there. It does not interest him yet.

II — Mars

Base name: The Red Death

Classification: Colonized planet. Military and scientific zone of Grand Patron Luigi's mafia.

Status: Occupied exclusively by the mafia. No independent civilian or cosmic presence.

Physical appearance

Mars is an arid, red planet, swept by permanent dust storms. Its atmosphere is practically nonexistent in its natural state. Its surface is riddled with ancient craters, dusty plains and deep canyons.

Since Grand Patron Luigi set up there, a planetary shield has enveloped all of Mars. This shield makes the planet invisible to outside detection. Thermally neutral. Acoustically dead. It exists on no active cosmic map.

Inhabitants and civilizations

Mars has no civilian population.

It exclusively houses the military and scientific infrastructure of Grand Patron Luigi's mafia:

  • Advanced research laboratories, some of them devoted to classified experiments.

  • Arsenals containing weapons of mass destruction.

  • Units of modified soldiers in permanent rotation.

  • The development center for the weapons used by Agent 47, notably the total sound-suppression systems.

The Two German Scientists operate mainly from this base.

History and key events

  • Grand Patron Luigi chose Mars for its strategic position in the solar system and its natural absence of life — no population to manage, no witnesses.

  • It was on Mars that the bullets made of unidentified metal and engraved with 47, used exclusively by Agent 47, were developed.

  • The experiments carried out on Mars have produced extreme results, some of which were sealed away or destroyed on Grand Patron Luigi's direct orders.

  • No outside cosmic entity has ever breached the defenses of The Red Death.

III — The Dead Planet

Official name: Mortis Iterum

Classification: Spiritual transit planet. Neutral cosmic zone.

Status: Inhabited by a single permanent entity. Mandatory passage for departed souls.

Physical appearance

Mortis Iterum lies several light-years below Earth, positioned directly above Hell and Purgatory in the vertical cosmic structure of the universe.

It has no sun of its own. No natural light reaches it.

Its surface is uniformly gray — stone, ash, silence. No vegetation. No water. No wind.

It does not move. It does not vibrate.

It waits.

At its center stands an ancient structure, built by no known hand: a vast open hall, with no ceiling, where departed souls arrive before being redirected.

Inhabitants and civilizations

Mortis Iterum is home to only one permanent entity: Death.

Death is the being responsible for collecting souls at the moment of passing. She retrieves them at the precise moment of their physical disappearance and transfers them to Mortis Iterum, where they are sorted before being sent on to Purgatory, Hell or Paradise.

She is neither kind nor cruel. She is functional.

She has never refused a soul. She has never released one without authorization.

Her role is absolute, her efficiency flawless.

Death does not appear in the Na Luve Ni Veibuli's race ranking. KJ knows of her existence, but she belongs to no faction. She is subject to no direct cosmic hierarchy — except, implicitly, to the structure of the universe itself.

History and key events

  • Mortis Iterum has existed since the first recorded death in the universe.

  • All the souls of the extinct civilizations — Inferis, Kaosu, Si Umatis, Na Luve Ni Veibuli, Демоны — passed through Mortis Iterum before their final judgment.

  • KJ watches Mortis Iterum through his soul fragment in Paradise, without ever intervening directly. Death and KJ have never fought. No reason has required it yet.

  • The planet is considered an absolute neutral zone. No war, no conflict, no attack has ever taken place there. Any entity attempting to interfere with the transit of souls would expose itself to undocumented — but universally dreaded — consequences.

IV — Solus

Classification: Isolated planet. Single-existence zone.

Status: Inhabited by a single being. Uncharted. Unlocatable.

Physical appearance

Solus is a cold, dark planet, with no atmosphere breathable for a standard organic being. Its surface is covered with plains of polished black rock and snow, crossed by silent, constant winds. Its sky is perpetually without visible stars — as if the planet existed in a pocket of the universe that light no longer crosses.

Its exact location is unknown.

No cosmic map lists it.

No entity — KJ included — knows precisely where it is.

It exists. That is all anyone knows.

Inhabitants and civilizations

Solus is home to only one being: The White Death.

The White Death is a hunting sniper. His origin is unknown. His species is unknown. His real name is unknown. He is mentioned in no official text of the Codex Infinitum, in no ranking, in no archive of the Sect or of Grand Patron Luigi's mafia.

He exists only in facts.

His specialty is simple: he tracks his prey across the universe — dimensions, planets, planes of existence — and eliminates them. Always. With no known exception.

Except one.

He has missed a target only once in his existence.

The target was Agent 47.

The details of that attempt are unknown. No one knows whether Agent 47 dodged, absorbed, or simply ignored the shot. What is certain: The White Death fired. Agent 47 is alive. No other record of a missed shot exists.

Signature

The White Death's bullets are white.

Made of an unidentified material — different from the metal used by Grand Patron Luigi, different from any catalogued material. They leave no trace of their trajectory. No visible impact on the surfaces they pass through before the target. They exist only at the moment of impact.

No one has ever seen The White Death.

No one has ever heard him.

We know he exists because his targets die.

And because, just once, one of them didn't.

Psychology and motivations

The White Death does not hunt out of necessity.

He takes no orders. He works for no faction. He is bound by no pact.

He hunts for pleasure.

He chooses his targets by criteria known only to himself. He takes as long as it takes — years, centuries if necessary — before he fires. He tolerates no competition in his field.

Any entity that tries to set foot on his turf — interdimensional hunters, cosmic snipers, elite assassins — disappears.

No bullet recovered. Sometimes no body.

No explanation.

Cosmic recognition

The White Death is known only to those who have survived unexplained assassination attempts, or to those who have lost targets they believed untouchable.

KJ is aware of his existence.

Grand Patron Luigi is aware of his existence.

Agent 47 is the only known entity to have survived a shot from The White Death.

None of these three beings has tried to locate him.

None has tried to eliminate him.

This silence is not fear — it's just plain, pure ignorance.

"Some planets are part of the universe.

Others exist outside it.

And some exist only because a single being decided to dwell there.

Do not look for Solus.

If you are looking for it, you are already a target."

— Origin unknown.

codex-chapitre-xxviii-les-territoires-de.title: Chapter XXVIII — The Domains of the Higher Incarnations and of KJ
codex-chapitre-xxviii-les-territoires-de.html:
A domain is not a place.

It is an imposed reality.

A space where the rules stop being universal.

Where the caster's will becomes law.

Entering a domain means accepting — willingly or not — that your existence now depends on someone else's.

General Rules of Domains

As established in Chapter V of the Codex Infinitum, domains are divided into several categories:

  • Simple domain: counters an equal or lesser domain.

  • Zone domain: traps targets in a defined space depending on the caster's power.

  • Soul domain: an ontological projection of its creator.

  • KJ's domain: a unique type. KJ can master every existing domain, but almost exclusively uses the form of the Imperial Palace, whose power cancels the powers of souls and objects.

The domains described below belong to the Higher Incarnations — entities whose power exceeds that of the known gods, and who stand immediately below KJ in the cosmic hierarchy.

Absolute exception: Grand Patron Luigi is affected by no domain, whether deployed by a Higher Incarnation or by KJ himself. This total immunity confirms his status as a cosmic anomaly equivalent to KJ.

I — Akuma: Infinite Death

Nature of the domain: A sphere of absolute void.

Main effect: Total control over the life and death of the trapped targets.

Description

When Akuma deploys his domain, it manifests as a perfect black sphere.

Inside: nothing.

No ground. No sky. No light. No sound.

No visible matter. No structure. No spatial or temporal reference point.

Only emptiness.

And in this emptiness, Akuma holds absolute power: deciding who lives and who dies.

How it works

Any entity trapped in Akuma's domain is subject to his instant judgment.

He can:

  • Kill without contact, without a gesture, without an incantation.

  • Keep alive targets who should die of their wounds.

  • Make a target swing between life and death continuously, without ever letting it tip over for good.

There is no defense mechanism against this control. No spiritual resistance, no artifact, no ability allows escape from Akuma's power while inside his sphere.

Immunities

Only KJ and Grand Patron Luigi are unaffected by this domain.

For any other entity — Higher Incarnations included — entering Akuma's domain means accepting that Akuma temporarily holds control over their existence.

II — Palace Demon: No Domain

Nature of the domain: None.

Main effect: None.

Special status

The Palace Demon has no personal domain.

His function is different: he controls the Imperial Palace itself — not as a deployable domain, but as an existing cosmic infrastructure. He manages its floors, its access points, its internal mechanisms, and carries out KJ's orders regarding prisoners, arenas and rituals.

He doesn't need a domain of his own.

The entire Palace is his realm.

III — Corrupted Void: The Fog of Illusions

Nature of the domain: A zone of perceptual and mental alteration.

Range: 21 kilometers.

Main effect: Total hallucinations and manipulation of subjective reality.

Origin of the power

When Void was captured and corrupted by KJ, KJ transferred part of his essence to him through a fragment of a soul fragment — a subdivision of one of KJ's soul fragments, representing a diluted but nonetheless devastating fraction of power.

This transfer changed Void's very nature, turning him into the third Higher Incarnation and granting him a domain based on illusion and mental corruption.

Description

When Corrupted Void activates his domain, a black fog spreads in a 21-kilometer radius around him.

This fog is not a physical substance.

It is perceptual.

It seeps into the mind of every target present in the zone.

How it works

Inside Corrupted Void's domain:

  • Targets see, hear and feel what Void wants them to perceive.

  • They may believe they are in another place, another era, facing other people.

  • They can be convinced that their allies are enemies, that their enemies are dead, that time has stopped, or that the entire universe has ceased to exist.

Void can create any hallucination, as complex or as simple as he likes.

He can make a target believe they have won, that they are safe, that they are dead, that they never existed.

To the affected target, these hallucinations are indistinguishable from reality.

Immunities

KJ and Grand Patron Luigi are unaffected by this domain.

All other entities — Higher Incarnations included — suffer its effect with no possibility of standard mental resistance.

IV — Tempus: The Master of Time

Nature of the domain: A zone of absolute temporal control.

Main effect: Total manipulation of the flow of time, per opponent.

Description

Tempus deploys a domain in which he holds 100% control over time for each opponent present in the zone.

This control is not global.

It is individual.

How it works

For each target trapped in Tempus's domain, he can:

  • Speed up time (the target ages decades in a few seconds).

  • Slow down time (every second for the target feels like hours).

  • Freeze time (complete immobilization, consciousness intact but body paralyzed).

  • Reverse time (local temporal regression, returning the target to an earlier state).

  • Fragment time (making a target exist simultaneously in several different moments).

Each opponent can experience a different timeline at the same time, in the same space.

One opponent can age while another grows younger, while a third stays frozen.

Limits

Tempus cannot alter time outside his domain.

Once the domain dissipates, the temporal effects stop — but the consequences (aging, wounds, wear) remain permanent for the affected targets.

V — The Assimilated: Imperial Chaos

Nature of the domain: A zone of total inversion of universal laws.

Main effect: Absolute randomness. Structural chaos.

Description

The Assimilated is the incarnation of Chaos.

His domain reflects that nature absolutely.

When he deploys it, the laws of the universe are inverted.

How it works

In the Assimilated's domain:

  • Gravity can reverse, vanish, or strike at random.

  • Light can become solid matter. Matter can become light.

  • Time can loop, stop, or move forward in unpredictable leaps.

  • Thoughts can become tangible. Objects can disappear for no reason.

  • Attacks can hit their caster instead of their target.

  • Movements can become reversed: moving forward makes you go back, striking causes healing.

Nothing is predictable.

Nothing is stable.

Nothing obeys any identifiable logic.

Control by the Assimilated

The Assimilated suffers none of the chaotic effects of his own domain.

He can navigate this absolute chaos as if moving through a stable reality.

He can also partially influence random events — but not fully control them, because chaos by its very nature escapes even its creator.

Immunities

KJ and Grand Patron Luigi are unaffected by this domain.

All other entities — Higher Incarnations included — suffer the total inversion of laws with no possibility of prediction or adaptation.

VI — Ignis: Hell Burn

Nature of the domain: A sphere of absolute fire.

Main effect: Total control of temperature. Combustion of reality.

Description

When Ignis deploys his domain, he creates an immense fireball that engulfs everything within a defined radius.

This fire is not ordinary.

It doesn't only burn physical matter.

It burns reality itself.

How it works

In Ignis's domain:

  • Ignis controls temperature at 100%.

  • The range of temperatures he can manipulate goes from 21,000,000,000,000,000,000,000 degrees up to absolute heat, a theoretically infinite number

At these temperatures:

  • Matter disintegrates instantly.

  • Atomic structures dissolve.

  • The concepts of solid, liquid and gas lose all meaning.

  • Local reality begins to crack under the sheer thermal pressure.

Ignis can modulate this temperature in a targeted way: keep one zone at a bearable temperature while plunging another into absolute heat.

Limits

Ignis cannot affect KJ or Grand Patron Luigi with his domain.

All other entities — even the Higher Incarnations — suffer the thermal effect with no natural resistance.

VII — Glacius: Infernal Cold

Nature of the domain: A sphere of absolute ice.

Main effect: Total control of temperature. Freezing of reality.

Description

Glacius's domain is the exact opposite of Ignis's.

Instead of heat, Glacius deploys absolute cold.

How it works

In Glacius's domain:

  • Glacius controls temperature at 100%.

  • The range of temperatures he can manipulate goes from 21,000,000,000,000,000,000,000 degrees below zero down to absolute cold, a theoretically infinite number

At these temperatures:

  • All molecular activity stops.

  • Atoms themselves freeze.

  • Local time slows down to an extreme — at absolute zero, movement ceases to exist.

  • Reality crystallizes and becomes brittle, fragile, ready to shatter.

Glacius can modulate this temperature in a targeted way, just as Ignis does with heat.

Limits

Glacius cannot affect KJ or Grand Patron Luigi with his domain.

All other entities — even the Higher Incarnations — suffer the cryogenic effect with no natural resistance.

VIII — Luxor: The Golden Chamber

Nature of the domain: A palace of riches and mirrors.

Main effect: Control through greed and self-reflection.

Description

When Luxor deploys his domain, it manifests as an immense palace of gold and mirrors.

Everything shines. Everything tempts. Everything reflects.

How it works

Luxor's domain relies on two control mechanisms:

1. Taking a treasure

Inside the palace, treasures, artifacts and precious objects are on display everywhere — gold coins, rare gems, legendary weapons, objects of desire.

If a target takes one of these objects, Luxor gains total control over them.

The instant the object is grabbed, the target's will becomes subject to Luxor's.

2. Seeing your reflection in a mirror

The palace is scattered with mirrors — walls, floors, ceilings, countless reflective surfaces.

If a target sees their own reflection in one of these mirrors, Luxor also gains total control over them.

The reflection becomes an absolute mental grip.

Nature of the control

Once control is established, Luxor can:

  • Command the target's actions.

  • Manipulate their thoughts and perceptions.

  • Force them to attack their allies, to harm themselves, or to serve Luxor indefinitely.

The only way to break this control is to leave the domain.

As long as the target remains inside, they stay under Luxor's hold.

Limits

KJ and Grand Patron Luigi cannot be controlled, even if they take a treasure or see their reflection.

IX — Glatorius: The Imperial Banquet

Nature of the domain: A zone of total absorption.

Main effect: Integration of all matter, energy and entities into Glatorius's mass.

Description

Glatorius is the incarnation of gluttony.

His domain reflects that nature absolutely.

When he deploys it, the domain becomes a zone of continuous absorption.

How it works

Everything inside Glatorius's domain is absorbed.

  • Solid, liquid and gaseous matter.

  • Energy in all its forms.

  • Living, dead and spiritual entities.

  • Objects, artifacts, fragments of reality.

Everything is integrated into Glatorius's mass.

Once absorbed, the element can never be recovered.

It becomes part of Glatorius — increasing his size, his power, his density.

Glatorius can absorb indefinitely, with no known limit.

His appetite is infinite.

Absorption speed

Absorption is not instantaneous, but it is relentless.

A target trapped in the domain feels their body, their mind, their essence pulled toward Glatorius, gradually dissolved, integrated layer by layer.

The longer a target stays in the domain, the more of them disappears.

Limits

KJ and Grand Patron Luigi cannot be absorbed.

All other entities — Higher Incarnations included — undergo absorption with no natural resistance.

X — Somnus: Absolute Sleep

Nature of the domain: A zone of hypnosis and dream manipulation.

Main effect: Immediate forced sleep. Total control of dreams. Real consequences of dream events.

Description

Somnus is the incarnation of sleep.

She manages every dream and nightmare in the universe — based on the memories, desires and fears of living beings.

When she deploys her domain, every entity present instantly falls into hypnosis and goes to sleep.

How it works

Once asleep, the target enters a dream controlled by Somnus.

Somnus can:

  • Create dreams based on the target's real memories.

  • Create nightmares based on their most deeply buried fears.

  • Invent entirely fictional scenarios that the target nonetheless feels as absolutely real.

Critical feature

Anything that happens to the target in their dream can have consequences in the real world.

If the target is wounded in the dream: the wound appears on their physical body.

If the target dies in the dream: they really die.

If the target loses a limb in the dream: the limb disappears in reality.

The dream is not an illusion.

It is an alternate reality whose effects cross the dream barrier.

Duration

Somnus controls the perceived length of the dream.

A target can live through subjective years in the dream in a few real seconds — or the other way around.

Waking up

A target can only wake up if:

  • Somnus decides so.

  • The domain is dissipated.

  • An outside force (KJ, Grand Patron Luigi) intervenes directly.

Limits

KJ and Grand Patron Luigi cannot be forced to fall asleep.

All other entities — Higher Incarnations included — fall into hypnosis immediately, with no possibility of resistance.

XI — Avarion: 世界は私の足元にある (Le Monde Est à Mes Pieds)

Nature of the domain: A zone of conditional total domination.

Main effect: Absolute control of the world. Elimination in case of excessive pride.

Description

Avarion is the incarnation of pride.

His domain is the only one that grants power to the trapped instead of taking it away.

When Avarion deploys his domain, every target present gains the ability to control the entire world.

How it works

Inside Avarion's domain:

  • The target can manipulate reality at will.

  • They can create, destroy, modify and command as they please.

  • They can enslave, command and dominate everything around them.

It is a feeling of absolute power.

Total intoxication.

A certainty of omnipotence.

The trap

If the target becomes too proud, Avarion eliminates them instantly.

Avarion judges pride subjectively, but mercilessly.

He detects:

  • Excessive arrogance.

  • Smugness.

  • Contempt for others.

  • The conviction of being above every law and every authority.

As soon as a target crosses this threshold — defined by Avarion alone — they are obliterated.

No warning. No second chance.

The elimination is total, instantaneous, final.

Nature of the test

Avarion's domain is a test of humility.

Receiving absolute power and not sinking into pride.

Controlling the world without believing yourself above it.

Few entities pass this test.

Exception

Avarion respects only KJ's authority.

He never defies KJ. He never judges KJ.

KJ can enter Avarion's domain without suffering any effect, whatever his attitude.

Grand Patron Luigi is not affected by this domain either.

XII — KJ: The Imperial Palace

Nature of the domain: A unique domain. Absolute power to modify reality.

Voluntary limitation: Usable only at 21% of its maximum power.

Main effect: Total modification of reality. Cancellation of powers and objects.

Description

KJ's domain is the Imperial Palace.

It is not a domain in the classical sense.

It is an autonomous dimensional structure — a space existing outside standard reality, summoned by KJ when he activates his domain.

How it works

When KJ deploys the Imperial Palace:

  • The surrounding space is replaced by the Palace.

  • The targets present are transported inside.

  • KJ can modify everything: architecture, gravity, matter, time, energy, physical laws, abstract concepts.

There is no limit to what KJ can do in his domain.

He can create. Destroy. Alter. Erase. Rebuild.

Instantly. Effortlessly.

Cancellation of powers

The Imperial Palace cancels the powers of souls and objects.

Inside:

  • Artifacts lose their magical properties.

  • Spiritual abilities are neutralized.

  • Opposing domains cannot be deployed.

  • Soul fragments, divine blessings, curses, pacts — everything is suspended.

Only KJ's will remains active.

Voluntary limitation: 21%

KJ's domain is so powerful that he can only use it at 21% of its maximum form.

Reason: beyond that limit, even his allies would take damage.

The Higher Incarnations, the Sect, the entities loyal to KJ — all of them would be affected by the pure ontological pressure of the Imperial Palace deployed at full power.

KJ deliberately restrains his domain to spare those he does not wish to destroy.

At 21%, the Imperial Palace remains the most powerful domain in the universe.

At 100%, it would become a threat to KJ himself.

Unique immunity

Grand Patron Luigi is the only being unaffected by KJ's domain.

He can enter the Imperial Palace.

He can undergo its modifications.

But he is never controlled or cancelled by the Palace's power.

This is one of the reasons KJ remains constantly vigilant toward Grand Patron Luigi.

Final note

None of the domains described in this chapter — except KJ's — has any effect on Grand Patron Luigi.

This total immunity confirms that Grand Patron Luigi is not simply an anomaly.

He is a cosmic equivalent of KJ.

And KJ knows it.

"A domain is not a weapon.

It is a declaration.

A statement that, in this space, you are no longer master of your own existence.

That someone else decides.

And that there is nothing you can do about it."

— Fragment of the Codex, author unknown.
codex-chapitre-xxviii-les-territoires-de.text: A domain is not a place. It is an imposed reality. A space where the rules stop being universal. Where the caster's will becomes law. Entering a domain means accepting — willingly or not — that your existence now depends on someone else's. General Rules of Domains As established in Chapter V of the Codex Infinitum, domains are divided into several categories: Simple domain: counters an equal or lesser domain. Zone domain: traps targets in a defined space depending on the caster's power. Soul domain: an ontological projection of its creator. KJ's domain: a unique type. KJ can master every existing domain, but almost exclusively uses the form of the Imperial Palace, whose power cancels the powers of souls and objects. The domains described below belong to the Higher Incarnations — entities whose power exceeds that of the known gods, and who stand immediately below KJ in the cosmic hierarchy. Absolute exception: Grand Patron Luigi is affected by no domain, whether deployed by a Higher Incarnation or by KJ himself. This total immunity confirms his status as a cosmic anomaly equivalent to KJ. I — Akuma: Infinite Death Nature of the domain: A sphere of absolute void. Main effect: Total control over the life and death of the trapped targets. Description When Akuma deploys his domain, it manifests as a perfect black sphere. Inside: nothing. No ground. No sky. No light. No sound. No visible matter. No structure. No spatial or temporal reference point. Only emptiness. And in this emptiness, Akuma holds absolute power: deciding who lives and who dies. How it works Any entity trapped in Akuma's domain is subject to his instant judgment. He can: Kill without contact, without a gesture, without an incantation. Keep alive targets who should die of their wounds. Make a target swing between life and death continuously, without ever letting it tip over for good. There is no defense mechanism against this control. No spiritual resistance, no artifact, no ability allows escape from Akuma's power while inside his sphere. Immunities Only KJ and Grand Patron Luigi are unaffected by this domain. For any other entity — Higher Incarnations included — entering Akuma's domain means accepting that Akuma temporarily holds control over their existence. II — Palace Demon: No Domain Nature of the domain: None. Main effect: None. Special status The Palace Demon has no personal domain. His function is different: he controls the Imperial Palace itself — not as a deployable domain, but as an existing cosmic infrastructure. He manages its floors, its access points, its internal mechanisms, and carries out KJ's orders regarding prisoners, arenas and rituals. He doesn't need a domain of his own. The entire Palace is his realm. III — Corrupted Void: The Fog of Illusions Nature of the domain: A zone of perceptual and mental alteration. Range: 21 kilometers. Main effect: Total hallucinations and manipulation of subjective reality. Origin of the power When Void was captured and corrupted by KJ, KJ transferred part of his essence to him through a fragment of a soul fragment — a subdivision of one of KJ's soul fragments, representing a diluted but nonetheless devastating fraction of power. This transfer changed Void's very nature, turning him into the third Higher Incarnation and granting him a domain based on illusion and mental corruption. Description When Corrupted Void activates his domain, a black fog spreads in a 21-kilometer radius around him. This fog is not a physical substance. It is perceptual. It seeps into the mind of every target present in the zone. How it works Inside Corrupted Void's domain: Targets see, hear and feel what Void wants them to perceive. They may believe they are in another place, another era, facing other people. They can be convinced that their allies are enemies, that their enemies are dead, that time has stopped, or that the entire universe has ceased to exist. Void can create any hallucination, as complex or as simple as he likes. He can make a target believe they have won, that they are safe, that they are dead, that they never existed. To the affected target, these hallucinations are indistinguishable from reality. Immunities KJ and Grand Patron Luigi are unaffected by this domain. All other entities — Higher Incarnations included — suffer its effect with no possibility of standard mental resistance. IV — Tempus: The Master of Time Nature of the domain: A zone of absolute temporal control. Main effect: Total manipulation of the flow of time, per opponent. Description Tempus deploys a domain in which he holds 100% control over time for each opponent present in the zone. This control is not global. It is individual. How it works For each target trapped in Tempus's domain, he can: Speed up time (the target ages decades in a few seconds). Slow down time (every second for the target feels like hours). Freeze time (complete immobilization, consciousness intact but body paralyzed). Reverse time (local temporal regression, returning the target to an earlier state). Fragment time (making a target exist simultaneously in several different moments). Each opponent can experience a different timeline at the same time, in the same space. One opponent can age while another grows younger, while a third stays frozen. Limits Tempus cannot alter time outside his domain. Once the domain dissipates, the temporal effects stop — but the consequences (aging, wounds, wear) remain permanent for the affected targets. V — The Assimilated: Imperial Chaos Nature of the domain: A zone of total inversion of universal laws. Main effect: Absolute randomness. Structural chaos. Description The Assimilated is the incarnation of Chaos. His domain reflects that nature absolutely. When he deploys it, the laws of the universe are inverted. How it works In the Assimilated's domain: Gravity can reverse, vanish, or strike at random. Light can become solid matter. Matter can become light. Time can loop, stop, or move forward in unpredictable leaps. Thoughts can become tangible. Objects can disappear for no reason. Attacks can hit their caster instead of their target. Movements can become reversed: moving forward makes you go back, striking causes healing. Nothing is predictable. Nothing is stable. Nothing obeys any identifiable logic. Control by the Assimilated The Assimilated suffers none of the chaotic effects of his own domain. He can navigate this absolute chaos as if moving through a stable reality. He can also partially influence random events — but not fully control them, because chaos by its very nature escapes even its creator. Immunities KJ and Grand Patron Luigi are unaffected by this domain. All other entities — Higher Incarnations included — suffer the total inversion of laws with no possibility of prediction or adaptation. VI — Ignis: Hell Burn Nature of the domain: A sphere of absolute fire. Main effect: Total control of temperature. Combustion of reality. Description When Ignis deploys his domain, he creates an immense fireball that engulfs everything within a defined radius. This fire is not ordinary. It doesn't only burn physical matter. It burns reality itself. How it works In Ignis's domain: Ignis controls temperature at 100%. The range of temperatures he can manipulate goes from 21,000,000,000,000,000,000,000 degrees up to absolute heat, a theoretically infinite number At these temperatures: Matter disintegrates instantly. Atomic structures dissolve. The concepts of solid, liquid and gas lose all meaning. Local reality begins to crack under the sheer thermal pressure. Ignis can modulate this temperature in a targeted way: keep one zone at a bearable temperature while plunging another into absolute heat. Limits Ignis cannot affect KJ or Grand Patron Luigi with his domain. All other entities — even the Higher Incarnations — suffer the thermal effect with no natural resistance. VII — Glacius: Infernal Cold Nature of the domain: A sphere of absolute ice. Main effect: Total control of temperature. Freezing of reality. Description Glacius's domain is the exact opposite of Ignis's. Instead of heat, Glacius deploys absolute cold. How it works In Glacius's domain: Glacius controls temperature at 100%. The range of temperatures he can manipulate goes from 21,000,000,000,000,000,000,000 degrees below zero down to absolute cold, a theoretically infinite number At these temperatures: All molecular activity stops. Atoms themselves freeze. Local time slows down to an extreme — at absolute zero, movement ceases to exist. Reality crystallizes and becomes brittle, fragile, ready to shatter. Glacius can modulate this temperature in a targeted way, just as Ignis does with heat. Limits Glacius cannot affect KJ or Grand Patron Luigi with his domain. All other entities — even the Higher Incarnations — suffer the cryogenic effect with no natural resistance. VIII — Luxor: The Golden Chamber Nature of the domain: A palace of riches and mirrors. Main effect: Control through greed and self-reflection. Description When Luxor deploys his domain, it manifests as an immense palace of gold and mirrors. Everything shines. Everything tempts. Everything reflects. How it works Luxor's domain relies on two control mechanisms: 1. Taking a treasure Inside the palace, treasures, artifacts and precious objects are on display everywhere — gold coins, rare gems, legendary weapons, objects of desire. If a target takes one of these objects, Luxor gains total control over them. The instant the object is grabbed, the target's will becomes subject to Luxor's. 2. Seeing your reflection in a mirror The palace is scattered with mirrors — walls, floors, ceilings, countless reflective surfaces. If a target sees their own reflection in one of these mirrors, Luxor also gains total control over them. The reflection becomes an absolute mental grip. Nature of the control Once control is established, Luxor can: Command the target's actions. Manipulate their thoughts and perceptions. Force them to attack their allies, to harm themselves, or to serve Luxor indefinitely. The only way to break this control is to leave the domain. As long as the target remains inside, they stay under Luxor's hold. Limits KJ and Grand Patron Luigi cannot be controlled, even if they take a treasure or see their reflection. IX — Glatorius: The Imperial Banquet Nature of the domain: A zone of total absorption. Main effect: Integration of all matter, energy and entities into Glatorius's mass. Description Glatorius is the incarnation of gluttony. His domain reflects that nature absolutely. When he deploys it, the domain becomes a zone of continuous absorption. How it works Everything inside Glatorius's domain is absorbed. Solid, liquid and gaseous matter. Energy in all its forms. Living, dead and spiritual entities. Objects, artifacts, fragments of reality. Everything is integrated into Glatorius's mass. Once absorbed, the element can never be recovered. It becomes part of Glatorius — increasing his size, his power, his density. Glatorius can absorb indefinitely, with no known limit. His appetite is infinite. Absorption speed Absorption is not instantaneous, but it is relentless. A target trapped in the domain feels their body, their mind, their essence pulled toward Glatorius, gradually dissolved, integrated layer by layer. The longer a target stays in the domain, the more of them disappears. Limits KJ and Grand Patron Luigi cannot be absorbed. All other entities — Higher Incarnations included — undergo absorption with no natural resistance. X — Somnus: Absolute Sleep Nature of the domain: A zone of hypnosis and dream manipulation. Main effect: Immediate forced sleep. Total control of dreams. Real consequences of dream events. Description Somnus is the incarnation of sleep. She manages every dream and nightmare in the universe — based on the memories, desires and fears of living beings. When she deploys her domain, every entity present instantly falls into hypnosis and goes to sleep. How it works Once asleep, the target enters a dream controlled by Somnus. Somnus can: Create dreams based on the target's real memories. Create nightmares based on their most deeply buried fears. Invent entirely fictional scenarios that the target nonetheless feels as absolutely real. Critical feature Anything that happens to the target in their dream can have consequences in the real world. If the target is wounded in the dream: the wound appears on their physical body. If the target dies in the dream: they really die. If the target loses a limb in the dream: the limb disappears in reality. The dream is not an illusion. It is an alternate reality whose effects cross the dream barrier. Duration Somnus controls the perceived length of the dream. A target can live through subjective years in the dream in a few real seconds — or the other way around. Waking up A target can only wake up if: Somnus decides so. The domain is dissipated. An outside force (KJ, Grand Patron Luigi) intervenes directly. Limits KJ and Grand Patron Luigi cannot be forced to fall asleep. All other entities — Higher Incarnations included — fall into hypnosis immediately, with no possibility of resistance. XI — Avarion: 世界は私の足元にある (Le Monde Est à Mes Pieds) Nature of the domain: A zone of conditional total domination. Main effect: Absolute control of the world. Elimination in case of excessive pride. Description Avarion is the incarnation of pride. His domain is the only one that grants power to the trapped instead of taking it away. When Avarion deploys his domain, every target present gains the ability to control the entire world. How it works Inside Avarion's domain: The target can manipulate reality at will. They can create, destroy, modify and command as they please. They can enslave, command and dominate everything around them. It is a feeling of absolute power. Total intoxication. A certainty of omnipotence. The trap If the target becomes too proud, Avarion eliminates them instantly. Avarion judges pride subjectively, but mercilessly. He detects: Excessive arrogance. Smugness. Contempt for others. The conviction of being above every law and every authority. As soon as a target crosses this threshold — defined by Avarion alone — they are obliterated. No warning. No second chance. The elimination is total, instantaneous, final. Nature of the test Avarion's domain is a test of humility. Receiving absolute power and not sinking into pride. Controlling the world without believing yourself above it. Few entities pass this test. Exception Avarion respects only KJ's authority. He never defies KJ. He never judges KJ. KJ can enter Avarion's domain without suffering any effect, whatever his attitude. Grand Patron Luigi is not affected by this domain either. Main effect: Total modification of reality. Cancellation of powers and objects. Description KJ's domain is the Imperial Palace. It is not a domain in the classical sense. It is an autonomous dimensional structure — a space existing outside standard reality, summoned by KJ when he activates his domain. How it works When KJ deploys the Imperial Palace: The surrounding space is replaced by the Palace. The targets present are transported inside. KJ can modify everything: architecture, gravity, matter, time, energy, physical laws, abstract concepts. There is no limit to what KJ can do in his domain. He can create. Destroy. Alter. Erase. Rebuild. Instantly. Effortlessly. Cancellation of powers The Imperial Palace cancels the powers of souls and objects. Inside: Artifacts lose their magical properties. Spiritual abilities are neutralized. Opposing domains cannot be deployed. Soul fragments, divine blessings, curses, pacts — everything is suspended. Only KJ's will remains active. But he is never controlled or cancelled by the Palace's power. This is one of the reasons KJ remains constantly vigilant toward Grand Patron Luigi. He is a cosmic equivalent of KJ. And KJ knows it. "A domain is not a weapon. It is a declaration. A statement that, in this space, you are no longer master of your own existence. That someone else decides. And that there is nothing you can do about it." — Fragment of the Codex, author unknown.

codex-chapitre-xxx-les-etoiles-speciales.title: Chapter XXX — The Special Stars
codex-chapitre-xxx-les-etoiles-speciales.html:
The Codex frequently mentions planets, kingdoms, dimensions and domains.

However, there are other celestial bodies that are far rarer, more dangerous and less understood: the special stars.

These stars do not follow the classical laws of astronomy.

They are not mere masses of fusing gas.

They are cosmic anomalies, relics of higher powers, or impossible accidents.

Some give light.

Others corrupt.

Others still defy existence itself.

To date, two special stars are recognized with certainty in the archives of the Codex.

I — The KJ Star

Nature

The KJ Star was not born from a classical stellar collapse.

It was created unintentionally by KJ himself, at the primordial instant of his supposed appearance in the universe.

According to the ancient texts, 21 seconds after KJ's supposed birth, one of his soul fragments went into ontological overload and exploded.

The detonation surpassed every known supernova.

It was not an explosion of matter.

It was an explosion of pure soul.

Effects of the Original Explosion

The shockwave is said to have caused:

  • the premature birth of several star systems;

  • the tearing of realities that were still unstable;

  • the appearance of zones where causality remains weak;

  • the immediate disappearance of primitive forms of existence that were never catalogued.

Some scholars consider this event the first known cosmic catastrophe.

Current Situation

After the explosion, KJ is said to have recovered what remained of the star and placed it in the Imperial Palace, suspended above the Throne Room.

It supposedly still floats there today.

It does not only emit light.

It emits:

  • fragmentary memory;

  • spiritual pressure;

  • conceptual heat;

  • residual divine authority.

Looking directly at the KJ Star without permission would lead to mental destruction or the partial erasure of the soul.

Symbolism

For the Sect of KJ, this star represents:

  • the birth of supremacy;

  • proof that KJ surpasses natural laws;

  • light born from the void.

II — The Black Star

Nature

The Black Star is a celestial body whose surface, light, gravity and structure defy all known science.

It is literally black.

Not dark.

Black in the absolute sense.

It absorbs, inverts or cancels any attempt at conventional analysis.

No standard universal law seems to apply there for long.

Hypotheses on its Origin

Two theories dominate:

1. Mafia Origin

The Black Star would be the result of an old experiment conducted by Grand Patron Luigi or his scientists, possibly linked to forbidden energy or to the manipulation of compressed realities.

2. Native Anomaly

It would have always existed as a structural error of the universe, independent of any deliberate creation.

No definitive proof confirms either version.

Observed Properties

The scientists who survived studying it report:

  • a stable absence of gravity;

  • occasional reversal of local time;

  • disappearance of objects sent to its surface;

  • objects returning before they were launched;

  • absolute silence, even during explosions;

  • impossibility of mapping its real mass.

Some probes are said to still be active there, even though, according to official records, they were never sent.

Use by the Mafia

What is confirmed: Grand Patron Luigi uses the Black Star as a secondary energy source for his mafia.

This energy powers, among other things:

  • certain invisible systems of the Mothership;

  • experimental shields;

  • forbidden laboratories;

  • unclassified propulsion prototypes.

Even the secondary commanders don't know the full extent of its exploitation.

III — Cosmic Danger

Special stars must not be confused with ordinary stars.

A classical star lights up a system.

A special star can alter a universe.

The KJ Star symbolizes power born of the soul.

The Black Star symbolizes existence freed from the rules.

IV — Forbidden Theory

Certain destroyed manuscripts claimed that a third special star exists, still unknown, tied to the final confrontation between KJ and Grand Patron Luigi.

No reliable document confirms this.

Everyone who tried to pursue this research has disappeared.

"Planets carry peoples.

Stars carry laws.

But some stars carry the end of those laws."

— Censored excerpt from the Codex Infinitum.

codex-chapitre-xxxi-dimensions-speciales.title: Chapter XXXI — Special Dimensions
codex-chapitre-xxxi-dimensions-speciales.html:
The universe is not limited to planets, stars or domains.

Some structures exist outside any cosmic map.

They are not governed.

They are not claimed.

They answer to no known authority.

They are called: Special Dimensions.

I — The Dimension of Shadows

Nature: Dimension of absolute oblivion

Origin: Unknown — not created, untraceable

Description

The Dimension of Shadows is a unique cosmic anomaly.

Unlike the other known dimensions:

  • It has no point of origin

  • It has no creator

  • It has never been observed forming

It has always existed — or at least, no trace of its appearance exists.

Fundamental function

This dimension acts as a universal receptacle of oblivion.

Everything that is forgotten is transferred there.

This includes:

  • Objects lost without a trace

  • Names erased from all memory

  • Civilizations that have completely disappeared

  • Deleted knowledge

  • Memories destroyed or never passed on

  • Abandoned or rejected concepts

Absolute condition:

→ The element must be forgotten by absolutely every existing consciousness

At that precise instant, it ceases to exist in standard reality

and appears in the Dimension of Shadows.

Critical property

Nothing can come back from this dimension.

Once totally forgotten:

→ recovery impossible

→ restoration impossible

→ re-creation in identical form impossible

Even KJ does not retrieve what is sent there.

Even Grand Patron Luigi has never accessed it.

The Entity: The Answer

Within this dimension exists a unique entity, extremely rare in the archives:

Designated name: The Answer

Nature of the entity

The information is limited but consistent:

  • It holds every existing answer

  • It never makes a mistake

  • It cannot lie

  • It cannot refuse to answer

It is not omnipotent.

It is omniscient within the scope of existing information.

Absolute limits

Two questions are forbidden to it:

  • How do you defeat Grand Patron Luigi?

  • How do you defeat KJ?

If either of these questions is asked:

→ The Answer self-destructs immediately

→ It disappears permanently

→ No known re-creation

Rule of questions

Every soul is limited:

  • 3 questions maximum in its entire existence

If a 4th question is asked:

→ The Answer self-destructs

→ regardless of the content of the question

Access

No method of access is known.

  • No ritual

  • No artifact

  • No domain

  • No coordinates

Unconfirmed hypothesis:

→ only forgotten beings could reach it

Status: Unverifiable

II — The Dimension of Chaos

Nature: Absolutely unstable dimension

Origin: Accidental creation of the Assimilated

Origin

When the Assimilated, incarnation of imperial chaos, was created:

  • A fragment of his soul went through critical instability

  • That fragment exploded

This explosion did not destroy an existing space.

It generated a new space.

→ An entire dimension

Nature of the dimension

The Dimension of Chaos is a permanent manifestation of pure chaos.

It does not imitate a domain.

It is not actively controlled.

It is autonomous.

Internal laws

In this dimension:

  • Physical laws do not exist

  • Universal constants are unstable

  • Time is nonlinear and unpredictable

  • Space is incoherent

  • Causality is not guaranteed

Observable effects

The following phenomena can occur without cause:

  • Reversal of gravity

  • Instant appearance and disappearance of matter

  • Transformation of energy into abstract concepts

  • Fragmentation of time

  • Multiplication or cancellation of events

  • Direct interaction between thought and reality

Every event can contradict the previous one.

No stable logic can be established.

Interaction with entities

Any entity entering the Dimension of Chaos:

  • Loses all ability to predict

  • Suffers constant random effects

  • Cannot stabilize its surroundings

Even the most powerful entities cannot adapt to it for long.

Immunities

Only two beings are totally immune:

  • KJ

  • Grand Patron Luigi

They suffer:

  • no alteration

  • no instability

  • no unpredictability

The dimension has no effect on them.

Control by the Assimilated

Unlike his domain:

  • The Assimilated does not fully control this dimension

He can:

  • slightly influence certain events

But:

  • he cannot impose complete stability

  • he cannot predict every outcome

The dimension remains true to its nature:

→ absolute chaos

Access

Access to this dimension is extremely unstable:

  • random openings

  • temporary spatial tears

  • chaos-related anomalies

No fixed entry point exists.

Conclusion

Special Dimensions are not domains.

They are not governed.

They cannot be owned.

They represent:

  • fundamental anomalies of the universe

  • limits to KJ's control

  • zones outside the influence of any hierarchy

Even the most powerful entities:

  • do not control them

  • do not fully understand them

And in the Codex Infinitum,

whatever is neither controlled...

nor understood...

is always a potential threat.
